cards.t: Bitwise launches US spot NEAR ETF amid surging activity
cards.b: Bitwise has launched the first US spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca following a massive rally and a surge in cross-chain volume via NEAR Intents, bringing significant institutional access to the token.

per.NEAR: ETF launch and surging volume via NEAR Intents provide a major fundamental tailwind.

cards.t: Kakaopay partners with Ondo and Dinari for tokenized Korean stocks
cards.b: Kakaopay Securities is collaborating with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore the tokenization of Korean-listed equities, expanding real-world asset (RWA) rails for international investors.

per.ONDO: Direct beneficiary of RWA expansion into international equities tokenization.

cards.t: Standard Chartered initiates coverage on Ethena's ENA
cards.b: Standard Chartered has initiated coverage on Ethena with predictions of a major price rally, bringing fresh institutional attention to the synthetic dollar protocol.

per.ENA: Major bank analyst coverage can trigger a narrative shift and retail inflow.

cards.t: Aztec relaunches zk.money privacy wallet on Ethereum
cards.b: Aztec Labs has brought back its self-custodial privacy wallet zk.money on the Aztec Network, joining a broader resurgence in privacy tech alongside Zcash protocol upgrades.

per.ZEC: Reinvigorated focus on blockchain privacy solutions indirectly benefits privacy coins.

cards.t: Cboe and S&P Dow Jones open door to tokenized options
cards.b: An extended licensing deal between Cboe and S&P Dow Jones paves the way for tokenized derivatives, marking another step for traditional financial giants moving core infrastructure onchain.
